description: Type system: a technical monospace for telemetry/data (the dashboard's real content) and a clean sans for UI chrome/labels, so the two never blur into each other on a data-dense screen.

data.role: All numeric readouts: endurance_hr, mtow_kg, soc, fuel_remaining_kg, power_kw — anything a judge should be able to scan like a HUD.

ui.role: Labels, nav, body copy, panel titles, tooltips.

usage_notes: metric_hero is for the top-line Key Metrics panel (endurance, MTOW, fuel burn) — this is the dashboard's 'hero' moment per the design brief, so it gets the largest, most confident treatment.

panel_title's uppercase + letter-spacing gives the six panels (Key Metrics, Pareto Front, Mission Profile, Battery SoC, Constraint Checker, Assumptions) a consistent 'instrument label' feel without needing icons to differentiate them.
Never use the data family for prose — it should read as 'this number was measured/computed', not decoration.
